title: 2D Gum-Net: Unsupervised Dense Elastic Image Registration via Symmetric Correlation and Spectral Pooling
abstract: arXiv:2611.12805v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Dense non-rigid registration, the recovery of a pixel-wise deformation field that warps one image into geometric agreement with another, is fundamental across medical imaging, structural biology, and correspondence estimation, yet learning-based approaches face a severe bottleneck: ground-truth deformation fields are notoriously difficult to obtain for real data. We present 2D Gum-Net, an end-to-end architecture that predicts dense elastic deformation fields fully unsupervised. We transfer the Geometric Unsupervised Matching Network (Gum-Net), originally developed for 3D subtomogram alignment in cryo-electron tomography, to 2D elastic registration: all three modules are redesigned in 2D, and the rigid transformation head is replaced by a Dense Spatial Transformer that regresses a sparse control-point grid, lifted to a full-resolution field $\Phi$ by bicubic interpolation. translated_title: 2D Gum-Net：基于对称相关与谱池化的无监督稠密弹性图像配准
translated_abstract: 稠密非刚性配准，即恢复一个逐像素的形变场，将一幅图像形变至与另一幅图像几何对齐，在医学成像、结构生物学和对应关系估计等领域中至关重要。然而，基于学习的方法面临一个严重瓶颈：真实数据的真值形变场极难获取。我们提出了2D Gum-Net，一种完全无监督地预测稠密弹性形变场的端到端架构。我们将最初为冷冻电子断层扫描中3D亚断层图像对齐开发的几何无监督匹配网络（Gum-Net）迁移到2D弹性配准任务：所有三个模块均在2D中重新设计，并将原有的刚性变换头替换为稠密空间变换器，该变换器回归一个稀疏控制点网格，并通过双三次插值将其提升为全分辨率形变场Φ。下采样采用DCT谱池化实现……
tldr: 提出2D Gum-Net，一种完全无监督的端到端架构，通过对称相关、稠密空间变换器和DCT谱池化等技术预测稠密弹性形变场，解决了真实数据真值形变场难以获取的瓶颈问题。
en_tdlr: 2D Gum-Net is proposed as an end-to-end fully unsupervised architecture for dense elastic image registration, leveraging symmetric correlation, a Dense Spatial Transformer, and DCT spectral pooling to overcome the bottleneck of unavailable ground-truth deformation fields on real data.
